method: Robustness grid for the anchored Bitfinex test, fixed before running; see www_theory/robustness.py.

x.median: Kraken hourly median of traded-minute closes (headline)

grid.reference_mid: mean of the Bitstamp and Coinbase log prices (the median of two)

instruments.E: Bitfinex ETH vs Coinbase ETH, hourly median of traded minutes
instruments.LTC: Bitfinex vs Coinbase LTC, hourly last close (UNIT-TD panel)
instruments.BCH: Bitfinex vs Coinbase BCH, hourly last close (UNIT-TD panel)
instruments.ETC: Bitfinex vs Coinbase ETC, hourly last close (UNIT-TD panel)

headline.J_df_formula: K*m - 1 with K = 1 anchor, m = 4 instruments (5 moments with the constant, 2 parameters: lambda and the intercept)
